meaning.zh:
“煞某人的风景” 或 “泼某人冷水”。

这个短语的直译是 “在某人的游行上降雨”，意味着在某人正高兴或庆祝的时刻，用消极的言行破坏他们的心情或计划。类似于中文的 “泼冷水”。
meaning.en: This phrase literally means "to rain on someone's parade," signifying spoiling someone's happy moment or plans with negative comments or actions, similar to the Chinese idiom "泼冷水" (pouring cold water).

lines.en: I'm sorry to *rain on your parade*, but the event has been canceled.
lines.zh: 很抱歉泼你冷水，但活动已经取消了。

lines.en: I hate to *rain on your parade*, but your project needs a lot more work.
lines.zh: 我不想煞你的风景，但你的项目还需要很多工作。

lines.en: Don't *rain on my parade* just because you're in a bad mood.
lines.zh: 不要因为你心情不好就泼我的冷水。
